'''menace64 Circle of Vader deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[menace64]]
* '''Published:''' 16 February 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)|Endor-D-endorlandingplatformdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Endor Landing Platform (Docking.txt |Download]]
